profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Full-Stack & Generative AI Engineer at Accenture, specializing in building scalable, intelligent, and user-centric applications across the entire software lifecycle. My work blends modern engineering with advanced AI to help clients streamline operations, unlock meaningful insights, and deliver next-generation digital experiences.

I design and develop full-stack solutions using Angular, React, Node.js, Express, and cloud-native architectures, while integrating GenAI models, embeddings, vector search, and automation pipelines that enhance performance and decision-making. I enjoy translating complex requirements into intuitive products and working across cross-functional teams to deliver impact at enterprise scale.

Passionate about innovation, I continuously explore emerging AI capabilities and best practices to create solutions that are reliable, ethical, and future-ready. I thrive in environments where technology, creativity, and business value intersect—and I aim to build systems that make work smarter, faster, and more human-centered.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Citigroup – Operating Fact Management Application via Accenture 

Worked on Citibank’s enterprise-level Data Governance and Operational Fact Management platform, supporting over 1 million real-time data signal communications between citi applications. Played a key role in building and maintaining a dynamic, automated Data Lineage architecture, offering coarse-grained data movement visualization via an interactive dashboard.

1. Developed modern, component-driven UIs using Angular 12, leveraging data binding, pipes, services, routing, form validation, and dependency injection to create intuitive and responsive front-end experiences.

2. Built and maintained scalable, asynchronous server-side APIs using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with a strong focus on performance, modularity, and security.

3. Designed and deployed a GenAI-powered chatbot, enhancing user interaction by summarizing data visually in tables and charts, significantly improving analyst productivity and decision-making speed.

4. Modeled and optimized database schemas using Neo4j and SQL/NoSQL, ensuring high-performance query execution, data integrity during migrations, and reduced latency for financial data processing.

5. Developed unit and end-to-end tests using Jasmine and Protractor, boosting code reliability and minimizing regression issues.

6. Identified and resolved performance bottlenecks in both front-end and back-end services, leading to noticeable improvements in application responsiveness.

7. Engineered data pipelines to ingest and transform structured and unstructured data from diverse sources into platforms like Kafka and Neo4j, utilizing Apache Spark for large-scale data processing and analytics use cases.

8. This role sharpened my skills in full-stack development, scalable systems, real-time analytics, and GenAI integration within a highly regulated, fast-paced banking environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Gemini · Generative AI · Transformers · Node.js · Angular · Talend Open Studio

positions.title: Generative AI Practitioner Engineer
positions.description:
Media & Entertainment Client via Upwork
Dates (e.g., Jan 2024 – Present)

As a freelance Full-Stack Generative AI Engineer, I led the end-to-end development of an AI-powered content analysis and recommendation system for a media and entertainment client. My work involved building scalable, intelligent web applications that enhanced the client’s ability to manage, search, and recommend rich media content efficiently.

Key Achievements & Responsibilities:

1. Developed and fine-tuned generative AI models (using TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers) for tasks such as auto-captioning, genre classification, and content summarization.

2. Built user-friendly Angular front-end interfaces for media editors and curators to interact with AI-generated metadata and insights in real-time.

3. Designed RESTful APIs using Flask and Node.js to integrate AI outputs with the client’s CMS and media pipelines.

4. Implemented robust backend architecture and microservices with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS (SageMaker, EC2, S3) for scalable deployment.

5. Managed data ingestion and enrichment pipelines using SQL and MongoDB, enabling structured storage of metadata, media tags, and recommendation scores.

6. Delivered an interactive dashboard that showcased content-level performance, flagged anomalies, and recommended editorial actions using NLP summarization and risk-scoring logic.

Tech Stack:
Python, Angular, Flask, Node.js, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, REST APIs, SQL, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (SageMaker, EC2), Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS

This project showcased my ability to blend AI research with full-stack engineering, delivering production-grade solutions that drove editorial efficiency and user engagement in the digital content lifecycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Generative AI · Generative AI Tools · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Django · Transformers · BERT (Language Model) · TensorFlow · Neo4j · Graph Databases

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Consumer IT – AT&T Inc. via Accenture 

As a Full Stack Developer at AT&T’s Consumer IT division, I contributed to the development, deployment, and modernization of enterprise applications that support millions of customers across AT&T’s digital services.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

1. Collaborated with agile teams to design, build, and maintain end-to-end application functionality using Java, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, ReactJS, JavaScript, jQuery, JFS, AJAX, and Oracle SQL.

2. Migrated the critical Customer Processed Snapshot microservice from on-premise infrastructure to Azure cloud, improving scalability, reducing latency, and ensuring high availability.

3. Played a vital role in implementing the Affirm Payment Service UI within the Opus Application, enabling flexible payment options for DTVNow (DirecTV Now) users through seamless UI/UX integration.

4. Participated in architecture discussions and transformed client requirements into scalable and secure solutions aligned with business goals.

5. Enhanced application responsiveness and data flow using ReactJS and dynamic client-side scripting.

6. Conducted code reviews, unit testing, and debugging for continuous improvement and to maintain code quality.

7. Used Oracle SQL Developer for writing complex queries and maintaining data integrity within transactional systems.

8. Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, ReactJS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Oracle SQL, Azure Cloud

9. This role deepened my full-stack development and cloud deployment skills while contributing to business-critical features that supported AT&T’s streaming services and customer payment operations.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Xfinity unily widget  processing via Accenture 
1. Angular Widget Development:
   - Spearheaded the development of custom widgets using Angular within the Unily platform, enhancing user interactivity and experience.
   - Collaborated closely with UX/UI designers to translate design specifications into responsive and feature-rich Angular components.
2. Azure Integration:
   - Integrated Unily widgets seamlessly with Azure services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security.
   - Leveraged Azure services for data storage, authentication, and other cloud-based functionalities.
3. ELK Stack Implementation:
   - Implemented the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack for log management and monitoring within Unily widgets.
   - Established effective logging strategies, enabling efficient issue identification and resolution.
4. Graph Query Optimization:
   - Led efforts in optimizing graph queries, enhancing data retrieval efficiency and overall system performance.
   - Collaborated with data architects to design and implement graph query solutions tailored to Unily's requirements.
5. Collaboration and Documentation:
   - Worked collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including back-end developers and system architects, to align widget development with overall platform goals.
   - Created comprehensive documentation for developed widgets, ensuring seamless integration and future maintainability.
6. Continuous Improvement:
   - Proactively identified areas for improvement in widget functionality,UX and performance.
   - Stayed abreast of industry trends and best practices, incorporating innovations into Unily widget development processes.

Key Contributions:
- Successfully delivered 12 custom widgets, contributing to a more engaging and dynamic Unily platform.
- Developed a real-time analytics widget using Angular and ELK, providing valuable insights to users.
- Optimized graph queries, resulting in a 80% improvement in data retrieval speed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Citibank – Sales and Offer Management Project
Dates (e.g., Jan 2022 – Mar 2023)

1. Developed and maintained robust full-stack features for the Sales and Offer Management platform, enhancing customer acquisition and engagement processes.

2. Built scalable and secure backend services using Spring Boot, including RESTful APIs, business logic layers, and service orchestration.

3. Designed and implemented dynamic and responsive user interfaces using Angular 10, focusing on usability, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.

4. Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams including product owners, QA, and UI/UX designers in Agile sprints to deliver high-impact features.

5. Integrated external systems via APIs to support offer eligibility, personalized promotions, and campaign tracking functionalities.

6. Ensured high code quality by writing unit and integration tests, conducting peer reviews, and following best practices in Git version control and CI/CD pipelines.

7. Contributed to the improvement of system reliability and performance through code refactoring, database optimization, and monitoring tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Agile Methodologies · Software Development · Spring Cloud · Cloud Computing · Unit Testing · Jenkins

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Aviation & Trip Support Company

Worked on the enhancement and optimization of the enterprise-level Online Flight Planning (OFP) web-based application used by a leading aviation and trip support services provider. Contributed across both front-end and back-end development in a collaborative, agile team environment.

1. Developed responsive, user-friendly interfaces using Bootstrap, JavaScript, and jQuery, ensuring seamless access across browsers and devices.

2. Applied C# in developing and integrating advanced APIs to support new OFP functionalities.

3. Utilized AJAX methods for improved data retrieval speed and performance without full-page reloads.

4. Gained hands-on experience with the ASP.NET MVC framework, including strong understanding of the Model-View-Controller design pattern.

5. Executed manual testing and logged issues using JIRA, enhancing application stability and user experience.

6. Performed unit and integration testing, validating both individual components and interactions across modules.

7. Collaborated with cross-functional teams under Agile methodologies, participating in sprint planning and reviews to drive continuous improvement.

8. Maintained source control using Git via SourceTree GUI, supporting clean and traceable versioning of code changes.

This experience provided a strong foundation in enterprise-grade application development, agile collaboration, and end-to-end software delivery, laying the groundwork for future success in full-stack engineering roles during my mMaster's program

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Junior Java Developer, I contributed to building a high-performance, real-time web application for a real estate firm managing contractor and developer interactions. The platform enabled seamless property search, project construction tracking, and job management—bridging users with live updates and efficient workflows.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

1. Designed and developed RESTful APIs with full CRUD operations (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) to handle property listings, user profiles, and construction timelines.

2. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to map and optimize workflows, using UML and charting tools to ensure production alignment with strict client deadlines.

3. Ensured cross-browser and cross-device compatibility for modern web interfaces, leveraging deep understanding of front-end rendering inconsistencies.

4. Practiced efficient object-oriented programming and object-relational mapping (ORM) techniques, while optimizing database structures and queries using Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL).

5. Contributed to the development and deployment of cloud-native applications on AWS, enhancing scalability, fault tolerance, and overall application availability.

This role provided a solid foundation in Java-based web development and modern API architecture while strengthening my collaborative development and debugging skills in a fast-paced environment.
